data.native_execution: unavailable on macOS; these are production binary validation and reflection checks

data.limits: Current AppleClang/macOS compile database; proves visible Vulkan host C syntax and static ABI assertions only, not native Windows toolchain or Vulkan API execution.

data.scope: Native Metal post-transform-cache snapshot evaluation, 640x360, SDR, spatial presentation without TAA, AgX, contrast 1.1, saturation 1.2, FXAA enabled, image sharpness 0.4.

commands.analytic_snapshot: env -u MTL_DEBUG_LAYER -u MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION -u VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS VKR_POST_TRANSFORM_CACHE=0 ./build_release/tools/vkr_harness snapshot --case tools/cases/local/post_transform_cache_bistro.case.json --profile tools/profiles/local-brdf-display-validation.json
commands.cached_snapshot: env -u MTL_DEBUG_LAYER -u MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION -u VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS VKR_POST_TRANSFORM_CACHE=1 ./build_release/tools/vkr_harness snapshot --case tools/cases/local/post_transform_cache_bistro.case.json --profile tools/profiles/local-brdf-display-validation.json
commands.snapshot_command_provenance: Reproduction commands reconstructed from the case/profile and effective configuration; parent executed the snapshots. See report case/profile provenance for exact invocation configuration.
commands.analysis: Python3 standard-library json/struct/math analysis; decoded canonical PNG with read_png_rgba8 from tools/checks/check_metalfx_accumulation.py; compared RGBA16_FLOAT_LE tuples and RGB byte differences. Visual inspection used view_image on both final-color PNGs.

upstream_hdr.interpretation: Two candidate coplanar raster-winner differences match the type diagnosed independently by the fog work. This evaluation did not capture visibility/normal channels to independently prove that attribution; exact full-image upstream identity is not claimed.

final_rgb.units: 8-bit sRGB code values (divide by 255 for normalized values)

data.visual_observation: Both final PNGs inspected. Cached output has smoother intense-card boundaries and reduces the broad bright fringes visible around some analytic-path card edges. Bistro background detail mostly matches. The large differences away from the two upstream pixels confirm a material nonlinear-filter-order quality change, not merely upstream noise.
limitations: No pixel-equivalence claim: applying the nonlinear transform before fractional FXAA samples and FP16 storage intentionally changes edges.
Only static 640x360 SDR Metal snapshots evaluated; no native Vulkan, EDR/scRGB scaling, editor, MetalFX/FSR or moving-camera acceptance established by these captures.
Bright saturated SDR interiors cannot prove extended-linear physical scale is applied once.
No timing claim: parent owns capture-free measurements; snapshot timing is auxiliary.
Full HDR byte identity fails at two upstream pixels; no broad tolerance or silent exclusion converted that failure into an exact-identity pass.
